// diagnostic

E0355

A scoped policy is unknown, conflicts, widens an inherited constraint, or is attached at a prohibited scope.

What

A scoped policy is unknown, conflicts, widens an inherited constraint, or is attached at a prohibited scope.

Why

One compiler-owned matrix resolves package → module → function → block while keeping the full declaration chain. Audited authority stays at its sound site.

Fix

use `#Policy(gc)`, `#Policy(explicit_units)`, `#Policy(copies: .Explicit)`, or `#Policy(sentries: .Off)`; write memory floors as `!Mem.*` effect denials.

Worked example
